steps.title: Use Pythagoras' theorem
steps.narration: The horizontal and vertical changes form the legs of a right triangle. Use Pythagoras to find the straight-line distance.

steps.title: Find the horizontal change
steps.narration: The second x-coordinate is negative one half. Subtract the first x-coordinate, one half, to get negative one.

steps.title: Find the distance
steps.narration: The squares add to two, so the straight-line distance is the square root of two.
